title: The incident report: facts, impact, cause and recommendation

videos.script: The incident report is the document that outlives the incident. It is what management, clients, an insurer or a regulator will read. {{readers}} It has four parts, and each rests on the one before. Facts, each with a source. Impact, what the facts mean. Cause, why it was possible. Recommendations, what would stop it again. {{chain}} In this lesson, every number in the report comes from a query you can run again. {{facts}} And every claim says how sure it is. A report that is honest about what it does not know is the one people believe about what it does.
